title: Measured roof geometry and slopes
discrepancy: Different surface area, face selection, pitch, overhang or length takeoffs.
calculation: For a planar face only: plan area × sqrt(1+(rise/12)^2); sum verified faces. Delta = corrected quantity × matching rate minus existing allowance.
evidence: Face-labelled sketch; field slope readings; aerial report limitations; perimeter/opening measurements.
carrier_counterargument: Carrier used a reliable measurement report.
reply_when_supported: Identify the specific face discrepancy and reproduce the measurement.
disqualifiers: No verified discrepancy; surface area already slope-adjusted.
double_count_risk: Applying slope factor twice; billing excluded/unaffected faces.
xactimate_action: Correct Sketch by face; retain original and measurement notes.
interpretation: Source IDs support relevant workflow or technical context; the discrepancy, calculation, response and disqualifiers are proposed harness controls, not findings about a particular claim.
priority_rationale: Measurement errors propagate across multiple area-based operations; verify early.
